summary.full_summary: Saffron Design issued an invoice to Gupta for a total amount of ₹13,715.52 on January 29th, 2019. The invoice includes three items: frontend design restructure, custom icon package, and Gandhi mouse pad. The subtotal is ₹12,246.00, with GST at 12% adding up to ₹469.52. The due date for payment is April 26th, 2019.
